name: code-simplifier
description: Tighten recently changed code, comments, and docs with four focused analysis passes while preserving behavior.

interface.shortDescription: Tighten changed code without changing behavior
interface.longDescription: A Codex skill that scopes recently changed code, captures a unified diff, runs four focused analysis passes (reuse, structure, quality, efficiency) with capability-aware delegation, then applies one behavior-preserving patch that reduces net changed lines.
defaultPrompt: Use $simplify to tighten my recent implementation diff
